title: Funnel Chart
description: Stages that only shrink — visited, signed up, activated, paid — with the leak visible at every step.
usage: For conversion pipelines where each stage is a subset of the last. If stages can grow or repeat, it is not a funnel; use a Bar Chart and keep everyone honest.
a11y: Every stage is a text row first — name, count, share — and the bar is decoration on top, so the whole funnel reads without the picture.
